_doc: The farm's job budget. The org is on GitHub Free: about 20 concurrent jobs on standard runners for the whole org, shared by every workflow here. farm-ci (9 jobs a run, 6 at once after setup) and farm-android (1 job, only for commits that touch Android) must always find room, so every background workflow runs one at a time through a fixed concurrency group and caps its matrices, and their peaks together stay within org_concurrent_jobs - ci_reserve. scripts/check-farm-workflows.py enforces this file on every push (farm-lint.yml).

on_demand.farm-ci: dispatched per commit by agents and goodfood-main; one group per commit, 6 jobs at once
on_demand.farm-build: one run at a time (group farm-build); images matrix capped
on_demand.farm-task: one run per branch (group farm-task-<branch>), a single job that pushes to that branch
on_demand.farm-lint: this check, on pushes to the farm
on_demand.farm-android: dispatched with farm-ci (the same trigger-ci) and by hand; one job per commit, only when the commit changes Android paths

farm-probe._doc: holds its 1 job all the time: a chain of ~5 h 40 min runs, each dispatching the next
